title: Yaakov Hadayva (or Chadayva)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Bava Batra 26b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.26b.2), where he asked Rav Chisda a question. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Bava_Batra.26b.2) explains that he was from Chadayev.[^1]

notes.text: Yaakov asks Rav Chisda who owns the cut wood. Rashi explains Hadayva as a place designation, and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2116&lang=en) cites the Arukh for the form of the name.
